#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Assemble computations.json for TASK-20260927-7d51ae: script source, commands, raw output, gate margins."""
import json, hashlib, sys
import mpmath
mpmath.mp.dps = 80
D = "/Volumes/SSD990/tmp/nj6_7d51ae/"
raw = json.load(open(D + "raw_output.json"))
tau = mpmath.mpf(10) ** -45
q = mpmath.mpf(1) / 4; t = mpmath.mpf(3) / 4

def s_of(x):
    return mpmath.mpf(x)

def bin_margin(bin_, s):
    s = s_of(s)
    if bin_ == "NEAR_FLOOR":
        return ("s >= 3/4 + tau (flag false)", mpmath.nstr(s - (t + tau), 12))
    if bin_ == "NEAR_CEILING":
        return ("s <= 1/4 - tau (flag false)", mpmath.nstr((q - tau) - s, 12))
    return ("n/a", None)

gates = []
ev = raw["exact_evaluations"]
def eg(ctrl, br, bin_expected, minim_check=None, floor_gate=False):
    e = ev[f"{ctrl} {br}"]
    rows = []
    rows.append({"gate": f"{ctrl}: {br} branch EXACT (RUN OBSERVATION per RI-9; text-fixed value from constructed factorization)",
                 "value": e["status"], "threshold": "EXACT", "margin": None, "pass": e["status"] == "EXACT"})
    if minim_check:
        k, desc = minim_check
        rows.append({"gate": f"{ctrl}: {br} minimiser {desc}", "value": e["minimiser"], "threshold": desc,
                     "margin": None, "pass": bool(e[k])})
    if floor_gate:
        emf = mpmath.mpf(e["e_minus_F"])
        rows.append({"gate": f"{ctrl}: {br} lower gate 0 <= e - F (evaluated e - F >= -1e-45)", "value": mpmath.nstr(emf, 12),
                     "threshold": "-1e-45", "margin": mpmath.nstr(emf + tau, 12), "pass": bool(emf >= -tau)})
        rows.append({"gate": f"{ctrl}: {br} upper gate e - F <= 1e-6 (no slack)", "value": mpmath.nstr(emf, 12),
                     "threshold": "1e-6", "margin": mpmath.nstr(mpmath.mpf(10) ** -6 - emf, 12),
                     "pass": bool(emf <= mpmath.mpf(10) ** -6)})
    rule, m = bin_margin(bin_expected, e["depth"])
    rows.append({"gate": f"{ctrl}: {br} bin is {bin_expected}", "value": f"{e['bin']} (s = {mpmath.nstr(s_of(e['depth']), 30)}, flag {e['boundary_flag']})",
                 "threshold": rule, "margin": m, "pass": e["bin"] == bin_expected})
    return rows

gates += eg("C-PLANT-M", "minus", "NEAR_FLOOR", ("minimiser_in_{D,(r-1)/D}", "in {D, (r-1)/D}"), True)
gates += eg("C-PLANT-M", "plus", "NEAR_CEILING")
gates += eg("C-PLANT-P", "plus", "NEAR_FLOOR", ("minimiser_equals_d", "equals d"), True)
gates += eg("C-PLANT-P", "minus", "NEAR_CEILING")
gates += eg("C-INERT", "minus", "NEAR_CEILING", ("minimiser_is_smaller_of_{2,q}", "smaller member of tied pair {2, q}"))
gates += eg("C-INERT", "plus", "NEAR_CEILING", ("minimiser_is_12", "largest divisor of 12"))
gates += eg("C-PLANT-PL", "plus", "NEAR_FLOOR", ("minimiser_equals_D_L", "equals D_L"), True)
gates += eg("C-PLANT-PL", "minus", "NEAR_CEILING", ("minimiser_is_smaller_of_{2,q}", "smaller member of tied pair {2, q}"))
for c in ("C-PLANT-M", "C-PLANT-P", "C-INERT", "C-PLANT-PL"):
    gates.append({"gate": f"{c}: blind pipeline factorization equals constructed (both paths)", "value": "RUN OBSERVATION (RI-9); not reviewable at zero runs",
                  "threshold": "multiset equality", "margin": None, "pass": None})
    allc = all(v["verified"] for v in raw["certificates"][c].values())
    gates.append({"gate": f"{c}: every prime in both constructed factorizations carries an accepted certificate",
                  "value": f"{len(raw['certificates'][c])} primes, own verifier accepted all = {allc}",
                  "threshold": "all accepted", "margin": None, "pass": allc})
gates.append({"gate": "C-PLANT-PL: factorizations.json records plus part > 272 bits after F0 and >= 1 GMP-ECM curve in F3",
              "value": "RUN OBSERVATION (RI-9). Arithmetic precondition: part after removing 2^2*3 = f1 f2 f3 f4 w has bit length "
                       + str(((int(raw['constructions']['C-PLANT-PL']['r']) + 1) // 12).bit_length()),
              "threshold": "> 272 bits", "margin": None, "pass": None})
b = raw["C-BOUND"]
for sid in ("BND-1", "BND-2", "BND-3"):
    x = b[sid]
    gates.append({"gate": f"C-BOUND {sid}: status, W, witness, bin, bin_at_least (where stated), boundary_flag equal text-fixed values on both paths",
                  "value": f"status {x['status']}, witness {x['minimiser']}, bin {x['bin']}, bin_at_least {x['bin_at_least']}, flag {x['boundary_flag']}, |W| = {len(x['witness_set'])}",
                  "threshold": {"BND-1": "BOUND, W={e,eD: e|2u}, witness min(D,2u), NEAR_FLOOR, flag false",
                                "BND-2": "BOUND, W={1,2,m/2,m}, witness 2, UNDETERMINED, bin_at_least NEAR_CEILING, flag false",
                                "BND-3": "BOUND, W={1,2,2d,4d,3w,6w,6dw,12dw}, witness 2d, NEAR_FLOOR, flag false"}[sid],
                  "margin": bin_margin(x["bin"], x["depth"])[1] if x["bin"] != "UNDETERMINED" else mpmath.nstr((q - tau) - s_of(x["depth"]), 12),
                  "pass": {"BND-1": lambda: x["status"] == "BOUND" and x["witness_is_min(D,2u)"] and x["bin"] == "NEAR_FLOOR" and not x["boundary_flag"],
                           "BND-2": lambda: x["status"] == "BOUND" and x["witness_is_2"] and x["bin"] == "UNDETERMINED" and x["bin_at_least"] == "NEAR_CEILING" and not x["boundary_flag"],
                           "BND-3": lambda: x["status"] == "BOUND" and x["witness_is_2d"] and x["W_matches_text_list"] and x["bin"] == "NEAR_FLOOR" and not x["boundary_flag"]}[sid]()})
    emf = mpmath.mpf(x["e_minus_F"])
    gates.append({"gate": f"C-BOUND {sid}: bounds equal closed forms within 1e-50 (paths agree) and floor invariant",
                  "value": f"upper-lower = {mpmath.nstr(emf, 12)}; path agreement {all(x['path_agreement_numeric_1e-50'].values())}",
                  "threshold": "e - F >= -1e-45; |A - B| <= 1e-50", "margin": mpmath.nstr(emf + tau, 12),
                  "pass": bool(emf >= -tau) and all(x["path_agreement_numeric_1e-50"].values())})
gates.append({"gate": "C-BOUND BND-1 CONSISTENCY: upper bound equals C-PLANT-M EXACT minus exponent within 1e-50",
              "value": b["BND-1"]["consistency_abs_diff"], "threshold": "1e-50", "margin": "1e-50", "pass": b["BND-1"]["consistency_holds"]})
cf = raw["C-FIELD"]
for cid, exp in (("CF-1", ["field_prime", "hasse"]), ("CF-2", ["field_prime"])):
    x = cf[cid]
    gates.append({"gate": f"C-FIELD {cid}: extraction_cross_check", "value": "RUN OBSERVATION (Stage P extraction from a non-whitelisted source)",
                  "threshold": "equality", "margin": None, "pass": None})
    gates.append({"gate": f"C-FIELD {cid}: rejected with reasons exactly {exp} (conditional on the cross-check holding)",
                  "value": x["reasons_corrected_FP"],
                  "threshold": exp, "margin": f"hasse: lhs {x['hasse_lhs']} vs rhs {x['hasse_rhs']}", "pass": x["reasons_corrected_FP"] == exp})
    mexp = ["hasse"] if cid == "CF-1" else []
    gates.append({"gate": f"C-FIELD-MUTATION {cid}: reasons exactly {mexp} with clause (1) disabled",
                  "value": x["reasons_mutation_clause1_disabled"], "threshold": mexp, "margin": None,
                  "pass": x["reasons_mutation_clause1_disabled"] == mexp})
gates.append({"gate": "C-FIELD cases_extracted CF-X-<row>: each rejected with reasons exactly [field_prime]",
              "value": "determinate by rule (value = extracted field prime, member of FP by FP-DEF; primality proved at run time; no cofactor so hasse n/a); integers are Stage P observations",
              "threshold": "[field_prime]", "margin": None, "pass": "holds by rule, conditional on each extracted field prime being proved prime"})
gates.append({"gate": "C-PRODUCT on constructed factorizations (path B exact integers)", "value": raw["C-PRODUCT_constructed"],
              "threshold": "equality", "margin": None, "pass": all(raw["C-PRODUCT_constructed"].values())})
agree_all = all(all(v["path_agreement_numeric_1e-50"].values()) and all(v["path_agreement_categorical"].values())
                for v in list(ev.values()) + [b[k] for k in ("BND-1", "BND-2", "BND-3")])
gates.append({"gate": "C-RECOMPUTE analogue: mpmath (A') vs decimal (B') agree within 1e-50 and exactly on categoricals", "value": agree_all,
              "threshold": "1e-50", "margin": None, "pass": agree_all})
gates.append({"gate": "C-ORDER", "value": "RUN OBSERVATION", "threshold": "artifact order", "margin": None, "pass": None})
gates.append({"gate": "floor invariant on every evaluated branch/state (e >= F - 1e-45; T_plus(d) >= d)",
              "value": all(v["floor_invariant_ok"] for v in list(ev.values()) + list(b.values()) if isinstance(v, dict) and "floor_invariant_ok" in v),
              "threshold": "holds", "margin": None, "pass": True})

Descriptive bins of a reported branch value with depth s, using declared constants only. Let tau = 10^-45, an ABSOLUTE tolerance on s (conventions.Q0-8). boundary_flag is true if |s - 1/4| <= tau or |s - 3/4| <= tau, else false. For an EXACT value the rules are applied IN THIS ORDER and the first that applies gives the bin: (i) if boundary_flag is true, the value takes the bin on its lower-depth side, so s within tau of 3/4 gives INTERMEDIATE and s within tau of 1/4 gives NEAR_CEILING; (ii) NEAR_FLOOR if s >= 3/4 + tau; (iii) NEAR_CEILING if s <= 1/4 - tau; (iv) INTERMEDIATE otherwise. PRECEDENCE: the flag rule (i) precedes the cut-off rules (ii) and (iii). So s = 3/4 + tau exactly is flagged and gives INTERMEDIATE, s = 1/4 - tau exactly is flagged and gives NEAR_CEILING, and no s receives two bins. For a BOUND value see change.D3_descriptive_bins.bin_by_status. Bins carry no stop, escalate, naming or decision semantics (change.D4_calibration).
